product.title: Chaya Capri
product.description: superdown Chaya Capri in Black is cut from ponte fabric composed of 68% viscose, 27% nylon, and 5% elastane. It has a hidden side zipper, a 16.5-inch inseam, a 10.5-inch rise, and an 11-inch leg opening. Hand wash; made in China.
